title: hedyotis lindleyana var. glabricalycina
intro: Hedyotis lindleyana var. glabricalycina, commonly known as the Chinese hedyotis or Ru-Xiang, is a plant species within the Rubiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of fever, sore throat, and other respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Hedyotis lindleyana var. glabricalycina include its ability to calm the mind, improve sleep quality, and reduce stress levels, making it a popular natural remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and provide a range of health benefits.
